component.name: XR
component.summary: Local-first AI agent with audited trust

description.p: XR is an AI agent that runs on your machine. It reads and writes your projects, runs commands, and works across the models you already pay for — while keeping a tamper-evident audit log of everything it did.

The desktop app keeps XR one keystroke away: a tray icon that stays up when you close the window, a global hotkey for the HUD, push-to-talk, and screenshot-a-region-and-ask. Updates are signed and verified locally; the app carries no telemetry, and a crash report is a file you choose to send.

ul.li: Runs locally: the engine binds loopback, and your keys stay in the OS keychain.
Audited: every privileged action is gated and written to an append-only chain.
Provider-neutral: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or a local Ollama model.
Sandboxed on Linux: skills run under bubblewrap with a seccomp profile.

screenshot.caption: The Control Room: every run and every span, in real time
Chat with approvals inline — nothing privileged runs without your say
The HUD, one global hotkey away while XR is unfocused

description.p: Desktop shell polish: always-alive tray, screenshot-and-ask, signed auto-updates, crash recovery.
